queries.question: Sir, when x approaches 0 for sin(1/x), why does the limit not exist despite being bounded between -1 and 1?

teacherReply.author: Er. Alifer Sir
teacherReply.text: Excellent question Rahul! While sin(1/x) is bounded in [-1, 1], as x -> 0, the argument 1/x approaches infinity and oscillates infinitely fast. It does not settle on any single unique real value L. Watch timestamp 28:10 where we plot this exact wave.
